defect: In this file the fix only turns the change's null-segment early return into D_ASSERTs; the actual crash was an off-by-one in update segment initialization in column_data.cpp/data_table.cpp.
reason: The repaired defect (too short a segment chain for morsel-aligned data) lies in other files and predates this change, whose next->segment->next correction is kept.

defect: The fix moves the string Finalize from MinOperationString into StringMinMaxBase so MaxOperationString also copies its result string.
reason: The missing Finalize for max(varchar) was created by the later merge commit 0a40af8, not by the lines of this change.

defect: On this file the fix only reformats the MERGE_THRESHOLD comment and the long if condition; the real fix (row id vector bounds in RowGroupCollection::Update) is in row_group_collection.cpp.
reason: Formatting-only change here, and the repaired update-id logic is older code in another file.

defect: The blanket 'Cannot use NULL as function argument' check rejects NULL for every read_csv option, breaking legitimate uses such as delim=NULL, quote=NULL, escape=NULL and nullstr=NULL.
reason: The fix reverts exactly the added check, and existing tests (read_json_objects, csv_nullstr_list, csv_parallel_null_option) pass NULL options that the check broke.

defect: The newly added FILTER check throws the copy-pasted message 'ORDER BY is not implemented for aggregates' instead of a FILTER message.
reason: The wrong user-facing error text is in the added lines and the fix corrects only that message.

defect: Sink takes the row ids from input.data[input.ColumnCount() - 1] instead of input.data[row_id_index], so it deletes and fetches by the wrong column when the row id is not the last column.
reason: The change replaced the correct row_id_index access and the fix restores it after tests failed.

defect: The fix continues the work-in-progress distinct ungrouped aggregate (passing the aggregate by reference, slicing the payload chunk, changing the output chunk types).
reason: This change only renamed SetDistinctGroupData to InitializeDistinct; the Copy() argument and the Finalize logic the fix touches were not introduced here.

defect: The fix reworks InitializeDistinct for the in-development distinct radix hash table (group expressions as child copies, no BoundColumnRef cast, aggregate not moved).
reason: The broken group expressions were added by later commits of the same work-in-progress series; the cast removed here only read return_type and caused no failure.

defect: UUID::ToString masks (lower>>4) with 0xFFFFFFFFFFFF (48 bits, 12 hex digits) but prints it into an 11-digit field, so the last group shows the wrong digits whenever bits 48-51 of lower are non-zero.
reason: The newly written ToString has the wrong mask and the fix changes it to the 44-bit 0xFFFFFFFFFFF.

defect: The fix removes the temporary 'return false;' that disabled the fixed-size map, after the map's iterator was repaired in fixed_size_map.hpp.
reason: The added line was a deliberate workaround that cost only performance; the defect it worked around lives in fixed_size_map.hpp.

defect: The rewritten operator++ uses a do-while that runs its body even when the prefix increment already reached end(), reading the occupied-mask entry at end.entry_idx, one past the buffer when the capacity is a multiple of 8.
reason: The fix replaces the do-while with while (*this < end), repairing the loop this change wrote.

defect: The fix reformats FromString and merges the ToString snprintf calls into one, keeping this change's corrected mask.
reason: Formatting and refactoring only; the change's own line survives unchanged in meaning.

defect: With a non-null but empty parser extension list, a failed parse goes to the split-and-retry path and the statement is silently dropped instead of raising the parser error; the fix adds options.extensions->empty() to the throw condition.
reason: The silent drop for an empty extension list already existed before this change (since 962b901), which only added the null-pointer check.

defect: key_vector and value_vector are bound to args.data[0] and args.data[1] before the args.data.empty() check, so MAP() with no arguments indexes an empty vector.
reason: The fix moves the references after the empty check; the out-of-bounds access is in the added lines.

defect: On the 'database is shutting down' path GetInstanceInternal unlocks, re-locks and unlocks cache_lock before returning nullptr, so GetOrCreateInstance calls CreateInstanceInternal with an unowned lock (assert failure, or unlock() on an unowned lock and a race on db_instances).
reason: The fix makes GetOrCreateInstance re-acquire the lock in a loop until the instance lookup is done under the lock; the broken lock handling was added by this change.

defect: The fix removes duplicate #include lines.
reason: Include cleanup only, no behaviour change.

defect: The fix removes a duplicated #include of prepared_statement_data.hpp.
reason: Include cleanup only, no behaviour change.

defect: The fix rewrites the new test case into a variable-size allocation test.
reason: Test-only change.

defect: The fix builds RETURN STATS unifiers from the column writers instead of schema.children and skips repeated levels.
reason: This change only added static linkage; the wrong stats-path logic predates it.

defect: The fix expands '~' in the persistent secret directory with FileSystem::ExpandPath.
reason: The unexpanded secret_path(secret_path) initialization existed before this refactor, which only added the db argument.

defect: The fix restructures the in-development compressed materialization header (renamed fields, bindings_after, new method signatures, comments).
reason: Redesign of a feature under development, not a repair of a defect in these declarations.

defect: The fix replaces ExpressionExecutor::EvaluateScalar with TryEvaluateScalar so constant expressions that throw (#4573) do not raise errors in the optimizer.
reason: Evaluating the BETWEEN bounds and other scalars with EvaluateScalar predates this change, which only restructured it.

defect: The fix factors the retry loops into RunQueryUntilSuccess and adds a disabled schema test.
reason: Test-only refactor.

defect: INSERT ... SELECT without a FROM clause is routed to the VALUES path (assert or null valuesLists dereference); the fix tests !valuesLists instead of fromClause.
reason: The same input already hit the assert/null dereference before this change, which only added support for selects with FROM.

defect: The fix enables the FIXME-disabled 'insert from constant query' test and adds checks.
reason: Test-only change.

defect: In the projection case the EnumerateExpression lambda inspects the outer expr instead of its child parameter, so column references nested inside projection expressions are missed and a projected mark join can be wrongly turned into a semi join (#13542).
reason: The fix changes expr to child in exactly these added lines (and also adds DELIM_JOIN).

defect: The fix removes the iceberg_to_ducklake (and st_makebox2d) entries from the generated extension function list.
reason: Synchronizing auto-generated autoload metadata with the pinned extension versions is configuration (the entry was re-added later), not a code defect.

defect: The new TryNegate computes SubtractInPlace(result, input), subtracting input from the caller's uninitialized result instead of from zero.
reason: The fix replaces it with NegateInPlace on the input; the wrong computation is in the added function.

defect: The fix rewords the unreachable 'URL needs to contain a bucket name' error to 'a path'.
reason: Cosmetic message change in a branch that cannot be reached because the path always starts with '/'.

defect: The fix renames LambdaColumnInfo to ColumnInfo, introduces LambdaInfo/ReduceInfo and routes list_reduce through ExecuteLambda.
reason: Refactor and feature work, not a repair of these moved declarations.

defect: The fix moves the in-development list_reduce state into ReduceExecuteInfo and reworks ExecuteReduce.
reason: The real bugs of this early version (unselected list_entries index, missing empty-list error) were already fixed by intermediate commits; this fix is a restructuring.

defect: The fix renames BindReduceLambda to BindTertiaryLambda and adds helper structs.
reason: Rename and refactor only.

defect: ParamsToString tests extra_info.sample_rate != 100 although the rate is a fraction (1 = no sampling), so every unsampled scan shows 'Sample Size: 100.00%' in EXPLAIN.
reason: The fix changes the added comparison to != 1, matching GetData in the same diff.

defect: The fix removes trailing whitespace and rewraps the constructor initializer lists.
reason: Formatting only.

defect: InitialNestedLoopJoin returns after filling STANDARD_VECTOR_SIZE matches without advancing lpos, so the last match is emitted again on the next call; the fix moves the full-vector check before the comparison.
reason: The same early return existed in physical_nested_loop_join_inner.cpp before this refactor moved the code.

defect: The fix folds the ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS lookup into one condition.
reason: Review-feedback style change with identical behaviour.

defect: The new AlterInfo::if_exists is hard-coded to false in the constructor and no Copy() passes it on, so a copied AlterStatement (AlterStatement's copy constructor calls info->Copy()) loses IF EXISTS, as with ALTER SEQUENCE IF EXISTS ... OWNED BY.
reason: The fix threads if_exists through the AlterInfo/ChangeOwnershipInfo constructors and Copy(); the flag and its non-propagation came with this change.

defect: Candidates are stored with best_num_cols instead of their own num_cols (wrong in the second branch), and NextChunk resets best_num_cols to 0, so the sniffer reports wrong column counts.
reason: The fix changes both emplace_back calls to num_cols and drops the reset, repairing lines this change added.

defect: The fix handles a NULL variant (value and metadata both NULL) by returning a NULL VariantValue and drops the validity assertion.
reason: NULL variants were already unhandled before; this change only relaxed an assertion.

defect: The fix removes the over-limit HandleOverLimitRows calls and the vector_ptr[cur_col_id] / number_of_rows-- logic that segfaulted.
reason: The crashing cur_col_id-based code was written by the later commit 7a28823 (removing selection vectors); this change's result_position-based logic no longer existed in that form.
